observations: Summary counters match the final register: 11 drawings, 24 image files, 3 added full-body bases, 112 total bases, 97 catalogue IDs and 96 production identities still without a full base, 115 gallery entries, 45 stages, 43 fighters and 24 costume families.
The three new bases are identified separately from the three static costumes; Charlie VAR-001 and VAR-002 share one image.
Crymini is explicitly a legacy 2017 design; the season_1 bucket is only a gallery filter. Blitzø Christmas is an imagined vision.
Reference-resolution limits, static-only scope, and historical deferred or refused targets remain visible.
Independent image-review notes describe the scope at review time; later technical/browser checks are summarized separately and do not imply 1:1 artwork certification.
limitations: No native Excel application was opened. Artifact Tool recalculation, changed-input restoration, reimport and OOXML inspection were run.
Rendered previews are reproducible internal QA artifacts kept in /tmp, not separate delivered artwork.
